episode.exact_only: Use exact-repair prefix, no candidate cost/query.
episode.immediate_k2: Move trained candidate into live shared store immediately and remove same-group exact cells, no query.
episode.shadow_wait: Retain candidate off live path, no query.
episode.query_policy: Hold candidate off live path; choose all1or2queries from initial predictions, then consume full budget even if a contradiction occurs. Learn each response as an exact local correction if mispredicted. Queryed keys cease being unseen. At end make exactlyone activation decision.
episode.acceptance: At least1new queried key in INITIAL disagreement set agrees with candidate, and NO queried key in that set disagrees. Irrelevant queries neverconfirm. Apply same criterion to budget1and2.
episode.rejection: If any informative query contradicts, discard shadow candidate; retain exact repairs and evidence. If no informative response, remain pending with shadow stored.
episode.stop: End immediately after decision; no later natural feedback or recovery from contradictory duplicate labels is tested.
episode.deployment: Transfer candidatewithout retraining; remove live exact cells in that context/meaning; preserve other groups. Exact-over-shared priority as prior source. Never rerun training based on hidden score.
